ITEM 1 | Bright red watermelon-like cubes and wedges with pale green rind edges, juicy and moist surface, cut into irregular chunks about 2-3 cm across, scattered in the upper part of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Halved and sliced bright red strawberries with glossy, slightly moist surfaces and white-tipped stem ends, pieces about 2-4 cm long, scattered on the right and lower right of the plate | 85
ITEM 3 | Small dark blue berries with smooth, slightly glossy skins and a small crown end, each about 1 cm across, scattered in small clusters among the strawberries and melon | 25
ITEM 4 | Golden-yellow roasted potato wedges with browned, slightly crisp edges and a fluffy pale interior, dry surface with some oil sheen, pieces about 3-4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, clustered on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Small smooth brown-skinned roasted potato or similar round piece, about 3 cm across, dense and matte with light browning, sitting in the center of the plate next to the strawberries | 35
ITEM 6 | Two larger brown roasted chunks with darker caramelized, slightly glossy surfaces and rounded irregular shape, about 3-4 cm across, sitting in the lower center of the plate | 90
